title: Consistent Noisy Single-Index Regression
exact_claim: Modify curved nonlinear single-index regression to be consistent for fixed nonzero response noise despite nonshrinking latent support of raw response slices.
scope_resolution: The short source asks for consistency without an explicit rate. This packet proves a fixed-dimensional guarded modification under extra assumptions, but does not settle dimension-efficient geometric consistency.
success_test: Noise-robust tangent/coordinate and regression learning, with assumptions and high-dimensional sample/compute costs explicit; an ambient-dimensional fallback must not be presented as the full efficient result.
